resources.name: price-index
resources.title: Evlek Price Index
resources.description: City/district market statistics from live Evlek listings — median price-per-m² bars for sales and median monthly rent for rentals, with the active-listing count and the statistic sample size shown as two separate numbers; districts below the confident-sample threshold render as text only, never a bar. Auto-attached to market_stats via _meta.ui.
